Full job description

Alder Peak Networks runs fibre and wireless links for coastal towns. We need a senior administrator to own the core network and the people who keep it up.

What you will do:

Run the firewall and wireless estate across twelve sites.
Plan upgrades and lead the overnight change windows.
Coach two junior technicians.

Pay: $45.00-$52.00 per hour

Work Location: In person
